image_description: A Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near a textured coral reef background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body/head and yellow posterior body/tail coloration.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small protrusible mouth with brush-like teeth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image resolution is too low to resolve fine details like 'brush-like teeth' or the specific protrusible nature of the mouth. The mouth area is visible but lacks the necessary detail for verification.
The eye is clearly visible as a distinct dark circle on the black head, proportionally large relative to the head size, consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed disc-shaped body with compact proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish exhibits a clear oval/disc shape typical of angelfish/butterflyfish, appearing laterally compressed in the 2D projection.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Striking gold and black coloration: anterior body and head black, posterior body and tail golden yellow with black margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The color pattern matches the diagnostic description perfectly: black front half, yellow back half. A faint dark margin is visible on the tail fin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous dorsal fin with spiny anterior and soft-rayed posterior portions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin runs continuously along the top of the body. While individual spines vs rays are hard to distinguish due to blur, the continuous structure is present.
The anal fin is visible on the ventral side, mirroring the dorsal fin's position and general shape.
The caudal fin (tail) has a distinctly rounded edge, not forked or truncate.

The background coral/rock textures appear slightly smudged and lack the crisp geometric complexity of real coral structures, resembling painted noise rather than organic detail.
Slight softness/haloing around the boundary between the black and yellow sections of the fish, though this may also be due to the overall blur.
